hero.title: Certified for high-security locks, RF openings, and SCIF rooms.
hero.description: Gateway Door Systems is Lockmasters certified, including Kaba Mas X-10 and LKM10K factory credentials, and works with Lockmasters. We also hold credentials for radio-frequency shielded doors and SCIF room construction.

preview.title: Certified for Lockmasters, Kaba Mas X-10, LKM10K, RF, and SCIF rooms.
preview.description: Our credentials cover Kaba Mas X-10 and Lockmasters LKM10K locks, radio-frequency shielded openings, and the construction of SCIF rooms for controlled-access facilities.

lockmasters.title: Lockmasters Security Institute Certification
lockmasters.summary: Factory-authorized training for high-security locks, specialty hardware, and secure door installation.
lockmasters.description: Gateway Door Systems is Lockmasters certified and works with Lockmasters. Lockmasters is a leading provider of high-security locks, tools, and professional training. This certification documents factory-authorized instruction used on specialty openings, including secure hardware coordination and installation practices required in controlled-access environments.
lockmasters.imageAlt: High-security reinforced door and lock hardware

kabaMasX10.title: Kaba Mas X-10 Lock Certification
kabaMasX10.summary: Factory certification to install and service the FF-L-2740B Kaba Mas X-10 high-security lock.
kabaMasX10.description: This Kaba Mas factory certification covers the X-10 electromechanical combination lock used on GSA and SCIF openings. Training includes measuring and fitting the lock, setting operating modes, recovering a lost combination, and the FF-L-2740B installation requirements. Gateway Door Systems holds this credential for high-security lock work.

lkm10k.title: LKM10K Lock Series Certification
lkm10k.summary: Lockmasters factory certification for the LockOne LKM10K lock series on FF-L-2890C openings.
lkm10k.description: The LKM10K certification from Lockmasters Security Institute qualifies a technician to install, service, and maintain the LockOne LKM10K lock series. It covers the FF-L-2890C specification, wood and hollow-metal door installation, and the mechanical and electromechanical parts of the panic and push/pull models. Gateway Door Systems holds this Lockmasters factory credential.

rf.title: RF Door Installation Certification
rf.summary: Certified installation of radio-frequency shielded doors for TEMPEST and electromagnetic control.
rf.description: This RF certification covers the installation of radio-frequency shielded door assemblies used where electromagnetic control, TEMPEST performance, and secure access must work together. It supports precise fitting, continuity at the opening, and coordination of RF-rated frames, seals, and hardware.
rf.imageAlt: Illustration of an RF door with a conductive seal

scifRooms.title: SCIF Room Construction Certification
scifRooms.summary: Certified to build SCIF rooms for sensitive, controlled-access facilities.
scifRooms.description: This certification covers the construction of Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) rooms, including the coordination of secure walls, openings, penetrations, and door systems used in ICD-705 related spaces. Gateway Door Systems supports SCIF room build-outs that require disciplined installation and documentation.
scifRooms.imageAlt: Illustration of a controlled-room door opening
